# Environment variables

Secrets (marked) come from Key Vault (Azure) or Secrets Manager (AWS) in the cloud deployments and from a git-ignored
`.env` locally. Configuration files only ever reference them as `${VAR}`; the loader refuses literal secrets.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `AZURE_TENANT_ID` |  | config/examples/azure.yaml |
| `BEDROCK_DEEP_MODEL` |  | config/examples/aws.yaml |
| `BEDROCK_FAST_MODEL` |  | config/examples/aws.yaml |
| `BEDROCK_REGION` |  | config/examples/aws.yaml |
| `FOUNDRY_RESOURCE` |  | config/examples/azure.yaml, config/meridian.yaml |
| `LODESTAR_ORG` |  | config/examples/aws.yaml, config/examples/azure.yaml, config/meridian.yaml |
